$comment: Every product image on the site, from the app's own captures (App/marketing/app-store/assets/screens, 11 October 2026, iPhone at 1320 x 2868 px = 440 x 956 pt). `screens` are whole screens, shown in a phone. `cuts` are pieces the app's captures were already cut into (sheets, rows, a notification), shown at their own shape. `crops` are rectangles in points cut from a whole screen by scripts/screens.mjs. Nothing is redrawn or retouched. See docs/SCREENSHOTS.md.
